_meta.source: handoff/vq2-recon-2026-06-29 (12 curated 640x360 frames + frame_stats_*.json, 3508 frames aggregated)
_meta.track: Now You See Me, Now You Don't (VQ2, build 1.0.3379)
_meta.principle: VQ2 look is FIXED and deterministic. Match this ONE appearance with high fidelity. Do NOT broadly domain-randomize colors/lighting; only jitter pose + small sensor noise.
_meta.units: RGB channels are 0..255 sRGB unless suffixed _linear (Blender Principled base_color / emission_color want LINEAR).

camera.note: Spec labels '90 deg VFoV' but that is the HORIZONTAL FoV; true vertical FoV ~58.7 deg. Always use fy=320. Camera optical axis pitched +20 deg UP about body-Y. Intrinsics are re-exported canonically from racer.frames.CAMERA_INTRINSICS_K; this block mirrors them for the Blender scene-builder.

gate.emission_note: Saturated emissive core (R>=252, strongly red-dominant) = vivid ORANGE-RED, NOT pure red. Plateau median ~(255,56,16); the higher mean-G/B comes from bloom mixing. At extreme-near range the core blows out toward (254,59,57) (G,B rise as the sensor clips). emission_strength is a starting Blender emission node value to be tuned so the rendered core saturates R>=250 with a ~2-3px crisp edge; calibrate against bloom.* below.
gate.material: emissive shadeless ring (the gate frame is a self-lit red square); the inner 1.5m opening is a dark hole. Bar/ring thickness ~0.175 * outer_side in image (recon frame 01: outer ~80px -> inner ~52px).

bloom.note: The glowing gate has an ASYMMETRIC bloom: one edge falls off crisply (~2-3px to background) and the opposing edge has a soft glow halo extending ~12-18px (half-max). Plus a pervasive low-amplitude red WASH across the upper scene (ceiling + distant gates) ~RGB(46,40,32). IMPLICATION (binding): extract corners off the SATURATED CORE (R>=250), NOT a low red threshold, or the ~12px halo + wash inflate the apparent square -> bias PnP range NEAR. The Blender glare/bloom must reproduce this: strong core, narrow crisp falloff, longer soft tail, plus a faint global red ambient. Mock renderer reproduces a symmetric approximation (crisp core + radial halo) sufficient for the round-trip correctness check.

scene.channel_note: Scene is VERY low-light / high-contrast. Per-channel means near-NEUTRAL (R~=G~=B~=35-37) -- the red is LOCALIZED to the gate glow, not a global tint. ~60% of pixels are dark (<32), ~1% bright (>224, the point light sources).
scene.dark_structure_note: Near-black warehouse structure (pillars, walls, parked drones, trusses) reads ~RGB(24,26,26) where lit at all; pure background ~(10,10,10).
scene.ambient_note: Global ambient/world light is very low (~0.04 of full); the scene is lit almost entirely by emissive gates + ceiling light grids + lane lines. Tune world strength so an unlit floor patch reads gray ~10-15 and the overall frame mean_gray lands ~36.

lane_lines.note: Blue/cyan floor lane-lines converging toward the next gate. The bright lit CORE samples as cyan-warm RGB ~(222,198,80) in the start-pad frame (a teal/cyan line bloomed against orange center-beam); the dimmer line wash is ~(124,98,43). Treated as emissive floor strips. They are TRACK-SPECIFIC guidance, not a detection target -- render them for realism + as the classical detector's blue-clutter negative (red-dominance rejects them).

floor.note: Floor is near-black with a faint regular GRID of thin gray lines (~RGB 43-48 where visible, on ~(8,8,8) floor). Grid spacing estimated ~1.0 m (square cells, perspective-consistent with station spacing); refine against a top-down render once Blender is connected. Non-emissive (lit by ambient/bounce); grid_line_strength 0 = pure albedo line, no glow.

structure.note: Ceiling = regular grids of bright NEUTRAL-white point lights (~RGB 237-238) on dark trusses; these are the main non-gate bright sources. Pillars/walls/trusses are dark gray (~22-26). Green pole markers ~RGB(80,252,80) flank some gates (emissive green); a few red pole markers too. White text station-number signs (01..20) on pillars. Numbered stations 01-20.

render_defaults.view_transform_note: Use Standard (NOT Filmic/AgX) so emissive cores clip to a flat saturated plateau like the real low-dynamic-range JPEG stream, preserving the crisp ~3px core edge the detector keys on. Add bloom/glare as a compositor/EEVEE pass tuned to bloom.* above.
